复制失败，请手动选择内容。: Copy failed. Please select the content manually.
请选择工具列表或变量引用: Select a tool list or a variable reference
搜索工具或输入 $ 选择变量: Search tools or type $ to select a variable
留空不额外限制: Leave blank for no additional restriction
可选的调用名限制；留空不额外限制，填写列表后仅执行列表中的工具。: Optional target restriction. Leave blank for no additional restriction, or list the allowed tools.
仅本批工具结果消息，不包含原上下文。: Only this batch's tool result messages, without prior conversation.
允许模型请求的调用名列表，说明可选。: Allowed call target names; descriptions are optional.
工具请求列表；没有请求时为 []。: Tool call requests; [] when no tools are requested.
本轮完整模型消息，继续调用前追加到上下文。: Complete model message; append it to the conversation before continuing.
按顺序执行模型请求，单次失败保留为错误结果。: Execute model requests in order, retaining individual failures as error results.
允许执行的调用名，与模型节点使用同一列表。: Allowed call target names; use the same list as the model step.
可选，已包含模型 message 的上下文；输出会追加工具结果。: Optional conversation including the model message; tool results are appended to the output.
上下文加工具结果，可直接交回模型。: Conversation plus tool results, ready to pass back to the model.
没有匹配的流程。试试其他名称，或上传一个流程文件。: No matching flows. Try another name or upload a file.
请先从 Library 选择一个流程。: Select a flow from Library first.
这个流程还不是对话 Agent: This flow is not a chat Agent yet
流程的 text 字段同时开启输入和输出，即可在这里对话。: Enable both input and output on the text field to chat here.
对话记录损坏，无法读取。: The conversation record is damaged and cannot be read.
本次对话超过 2000 步，请到 Editor 检查循环。: This conversation exceeded 2000 steps. Check loops in Editor.
这个流程没有返回文字 text，请到 Editor 设置输出。: The flow did not return a text string. Configure its output in Editor.
回答已生成，但对话记录保存失败。请检查浏览器存储空间。: The reply was generated but could not be saved. Check browser storage.
选择一个步骤，编辑它的参数。: Select a step to edit its parameters.
已保存到 Library，下一次从头运行。: Saved to Library. The next run starts from the beginning.
运行失败，请检查错误步骤。: Run failed. Check the failing step.
已暂停，可以继续运行。: Paused. You can edit values and continue.
组合步骤，让 Agent 按你的方式工作。: Build steps to make your Agent work your way.
点击步骤名称，编辑输入、输出与调用参数。支持直接填写 JSON 或 YAML。: Select a step to edit its inputs, outputs and parameters. JSON and YAML are supported.
变量名不能为空或重复。: Variable names must be non-empty and unique.
请输入列表，例如 [1, 2] 或 YAML 列表: Enter an array such as [1, 2] or a YAML list
分支内的步骤在左侧步骤列表中编辑。引用一个判断结果变量即可。: Edit branch steps in the step list. You can reference a condition variable.
可编辑导入的子流程引用；浏览器暂不支持加载外部子流程。: Subflow references can be edited. External subflows cannot be loaded in the browser yet.
此值不是 JSON 数据，请在工具中处理: This value is not JSON data. Handle it in the tool.
参数名不能为空或重复: Parameter names must be non-empty and unique
填写该服务提供的模型 ID: Enter a model ID supported by this service
服务地址（留空使用官方地址）: Base URL (leave blank for the official endpoint)
允许首次运行时下载免费本地模型（约 1.44 GB 权重，另需运行库）: Allow downloading the free local model (about 1.44 GB of weights, plus runtime)
配置仅保留在当前页面，刷新后清除；密钥不写入流程。API 请求由浏览器直接发送到: Settings stay in this page and reset on reload. Keys are not saved in flows. API requests go directly to the configured endpoint, which must support CORS.
本地模型使用设备 WebGPU，不需要 API Key。后续复用缓存；并非所有手: The local model uses WebGPU and needs no API key. Downloads are cached. Some phones are unsupported. Canceling a local call releases the model.
{{name}} 超过 5 MB，无法导入。: {{name}} exceeds 5 MB and cannot be imported.
分支内的步骤在列表中展开编辑。引用一个判断结果变量即可。: Expand the branch in the step list to edit its steps. Reference a condition variable here.
免费本地模型约 1.44 GB 权重，另需运行库；后续复用缓存。: The free model has about 1.44 GB of weights plus runtime files. Later runs use the cache.
确定删除对话「{{name}}」吗？聊天记录将被移除，流程和工具存储不会删除。: Delete “{{name}}”? Chat history will be removed. Flows and tool storage will be kept.
此变量仍被步骤引用，请先移除引用再删除。: This variable is still referenced by steps. Remove those references before deleting it.
确认删除所有变量及其默认值和运行值？: Delete all variables, including their defaults and run values?
确认删除所有流程步骤（包括嵌套步骤）？: Delete all workflow steps, including nested steps?
变量仍被步骤引用，请先移除引用或清空步骤。: Variables are still referenced by steps. Remove the references or clear the steps first.
流程名称不能与内置工具重名: Flow names must not match built-in tools
浏览器暂不支持外部流程：{{name}}: External flows are not supported in the browser: {{name}}
已存在名为「{{name}}」的流程，请使用其他名称。: A flow named “{{name}}” already exists. Choose another name.
请先选择可用的调用目标: Select an available call target first
应用时将移除未声明的参数：{{names}}: Undeclared parameters will be removed on apply: {{names}}
这个流程没有返回文字 chatOut，请到 Editor 设置输出。: This flow did not return text in chatOut. Configure its output in Editor.
流程的 chatOut 变量开启输出，即可在这里对话。: Enable output on chatOut to use this flow in chat.
用 $变量名$ 插入变量，$$ 显示 $；保留换行和缩进。: Use $name$ for variables and $$ for a literal $. Line breaks and indentation are preserved.
请在设置中配置默认模型: Configure a default model in settings
分组不创建变量作用域，内部步骤按顺序执行。: Groups share the same variables and execute their steps in order.
文本或 system / user / assistant 消息列表。: Text or a list of system / user / assistant messages.
每个调用步骤独立设置，也可以引用运行变量。: Configure each call independently, or reference runtime variables.
服务令牌。可填写 $变量名，避免将令牌直接保存在流程中。: Service token. Reference $variable to avoid saving the token in the flow.
最多生成 512 token，输入与输出共用 2048 token 上下文。: Up to 512 output tokens; input and output share a 2048-token context.
选择 json 时必填 JSON Schema 对象；text 模式留空。: Required JSON Schema object for json output; leave unset for text.
文本或解析后的 JSON 结果。: Text or the parsed JSON result.
生成停止的原因。本地调用暂不提供。: Reason generation stopped. Not currently available for local calls.
服务返回的 token 用量。本地调用暂不提供。: Token usage reported by the service. Not currently available for local calls.
存储键，可用 / 分组。: Storage key. Use / to organize keys.
拖到这里移入分组: Drop here to move into this group
拖到这里移到外层: Drop here to move to the outer level
有效流程，保存后可用流程编辑器打开。: Valid flow. Save to open it in the flow editor.
删除此路径及其所有内容：: Delete this path and all its contents:
移动后请更新引用此路径的流程和脚本。: After moving, update flows and scripts referencing this path.
Script path or HTTPS URL; choose script: Script path or HTTPS URL; choose script or code.
Inline ES module source; choose code or: Inline ES module source; choose code or script.
新建流程，或导入文件开始。: Create a flow or import files to get started.
设置输出，继续执行；最后一次调用生效。: Set output and continue; the last call wins.
ES module source. Read input and set out: Read input and set output with result(value).
仅对后续运行生效，会增加内存占用。: Applies to subsequent runs only. Uses additional memory.
仅保存在内存中，刷新后清除；最多保留 8 轮，总文本约 512 KB。: Memory only; cleared on reload. Up to 8 runs and about 512 KB of text.
设置上下文最前面的唯一 system 消息，替换已有系统提示，不重复追加。: Set the single system message at the beginning of the context, replacing existing system prompts without duplicates.
HTTP 方法，例如 GET、POST、PUT、PATCH、DELETE、HEA: HTTP method, such as GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE or HEAD. GET/HEAD cannot include a body.
请求头对象，值必须是字符串，例如 {\"Content-Type\": \"ap: Request headers with string values, such as {"Content-Type": "application/json"}. Browser CORS and header restrictions apply.
对象或数组自动编码为 JSON；字符串原样发送；未设置则不发送。: Objects and arrays are encoded as JSON; strings are sent unchanged; unset sends no body.
JSON 响应解析为数据，文本响应为字符串；无响应体为 null。: JSON responses are parsed into data; text responses remain strings; no response body returns null.
下载分块保存在此浏览器，暂停或停止后可继续；释放会停止下载并释放模型内存，保留下: Downloaded chunks stay in this browser for resuming. Release stops the download and frees model memory while keeping downloaded data.
提前初始化本地模型，缩短首次对话等待；会占用设备内存。: Initialize the local model ahead of time to reduce the first chat wait. Uses device memory.
本地模型尚未初始化: Local model has not been initialized
正在初始化本地模型，可能需要几分钟，请耐心等待。: Initializing the local model. This may take a few minutes. Please wait.
请先停止此会话，再删除。: Stop this conversation before deleting it.
另一会话正在运行，完成后可发送。: Another session is running. You can send after it finishes.
会话记录尚未加载。: Conversation history has not loaded yet.
没有配置 API Key 时使用本地模型。连接设置保存在此浏览器中，API Ke: Uses the local model when no API Key is configured. Connections are saved in this browser; API Keys are not written into flow files.
全局环境作为所有对话和编辑器运行的默认值。: Global environment provides defaults for conversations and editor runs.
环境已保存，下次运行生效。: Environment saved. Changes apply to the next run.
环境值保存在本机浏览器，不随流程导出；敏感标记仅遮挡显示，不加密，也不限制工具读: Environment values stay in this browser and are excluded from flow exports. Sensitive marks mask display; they do not encrypt or restrict tool access.
当前对话优先使用这里的值；未设置的变量使用全局值。: This conversation overrides global values; unset variables use global defaults.
环境已自动保存，下次运行生效。: Environment saved automatically. Changes apply to the next run.
此环境仅用于当前文件的编辑器运行测试；未设置的变量使用全局值。: This environment applies only to editor tests of the current file. Unset variables use global defaults.
